source: Beds: Drive sheet 'Lapland Lake Lodging – Beds and Sleeping' (from laplandlake.com/lodging, Oct 30, 2026). Other facts: Company Brain.

included.title: Every stay
items: Full private kitchen: refrigerator, stove with oven, microwave, drip coffee maker, toaster, dishes, utensils, pots and pans, and kitchen towels
Sauna, with men’s and women’s hours

included.title: Winter Lodging
items: Free trail pass for every registered lodging guest
Night skiing on the Lake Trail, 6–9 pm, for lodging guests only
Night tubing on the junior tubing hill, 6–9 pm, for lodging guests only
Electric heat in every unit, and a forced hot air furnace in the farmhouse
Indoor firewood delivered daily to units with a wood stove

included.title: Summer and Fall Lodging
items: Kayaks, canoes and rowboats, free to use
Life jackets and paddles, free to use
Each unit has a campfire ring, outdoor chairs, picnic table and charcoal grill
